description_for_human: Browse and reference Data Center Training's catalog of 44 online data center courses covering design, operations, power, cooling, security, and facilities management.
description_for_model: Read-only informational manifest for Data Center Training (datacentertraining.us). Use the referenced resources to answer questions about available courses, pricing, duration, accreditation, and industry standards alignment (ANSI/TIA-942, NFPA 70E, Uptime Institute Tier Framework, ASHRAE, SOC 2/ISO 27001, OSHA). There is no authenticated API; all data is served as static, publicly readable documents.
